Resolves #21133

Under `useInternalId: false`, a record keyed `0` is now treated as a real row id across the grid selection models: the row paints as selected in every body, `getRowRecord(0)` resolves the record, and `ArrowUp`/`ArrowDown` can leave and land on the row. Six truthiness checks (`!id`, `!recordIds`, `selectedRows[0] || fallback`, `if (recordId)`) in `src/selection/grid` became `== null` / `??` / `!= null`, matching the codebase idiom; behavior for `null` and `undefined` ids is unchanged.

Evidence: the ticket's probe showed `getRowRecord(0) → null` and no painted selection for key `0` → the fix flips exactly the six guards the ticket names. Residual: the ticket's last AC (a `view.selectedRecords` spec once #21132 merges) is unverifiable until that PR lands; #21132 is still open at this writing. Residual-Owner: #21132.

## AC Evidence
| AC-1 (`selectRow(0)` paints in every body) | CI-covered: `test/playwright/unit/grid/ViewOwnedSelectionModel.spec.mjs` › "selectRow(0) paints the row keyed 0 in every body, and getRowRecord resolves only real ids" |
| AC-2 (`getRowRecord(0)` resolves; `null`/`undefined` still null) | CI-covered: same spec, `getRowRecord` assertions |
| AC-3 (`ArrowDown`/`ArrowUp` off and onto key `0`, `0` not first, RowModel + CellRowModel) | CI-covered: specs "RowModel: ArrowDown moves off the row keyed 0…" and "CellRowModel: ArrowDown moves off the row keyed 0…" (key map puts `0` on the second row) |
| AC-4 (new specs fail on `dev` before the fix) | outside-CI: ran the three new specs with the `src/selection/grid` changes stashed → 3 failed; with the fix → 24/24 pass. Command: `npx playwright test -c test/playwright/playwright.config.unit.mjs test/playwright/unit/grid/ViewOwnedSelectionModel.spec.mjs` |
| AC-5 (`selectedRecords` spec if #21132 merged) | Not applicable yet: #21132 is open; noted as residual above |
